builds.name: Anti-tunnel
builds.why: For when the killer camps or tunnels: two perks protect you right after an unhook, then a burst of speed to get away.

builds.name: Gen speed
builds.why: Finds the three gens that are close together and finishes them fast, alone or with a friend.

builds.name: Healer
builds.why: Keeps the team healthy and shows where everyone is when someone's hooked.

builds.name: Chase
builds.why: Shows the pallets and windows near you and gets you through them faster.

builds.name: Solo queue info
builds.why: For random teammates: see what they're doing and where the loops are.

builds.name: Stealth
builds.why: Hard to find: hides your aura from killer perks and keeps you quiet.

builds.name: Slowdown
builds.why: Slows the gens down every time you hook someone, so you have time for chases.

builds.name: Info and chase
builds.why: Find survivors quickly at the start and after each hook; Bamboozle stops a window loop.

builds.name: Endgame
builds.why: Holds the exit gates shut for longer so the last hook still counts.

builds.name: Anti-loop
builds.why: For killers without a chase power: break pallets fast and shrug off stuns.

builds.name: Hex totems
builds.why: For fun: strong if the survivors don't find your totems.

builds.name: Carry
builds.why: Get survivors to a hook from far away, and punish anyone who comes to save them.
